caption: Zucchini day for my one year old toddler Zen ✌️ All you need is a zucchini, olive oil, cheese and puff pastry! (+herbs and other seasonings of your choice of course 👀). I used grated parmesan cheese and oregano.  This recipe is baby-friendly, and for adults, I recommend adding more cheese & seasoning of your choice to enhance flavor!✨ Bake time depends on your puff pastry type! I used @dufourpastrykitchens vegan pastry dough which suggested 30-35 min at 400F. 🙂 Also if you’re looking for good olive oil, I recommend @kosterina for rich fragrance!🫒 . . . . #babyledweaning#weaning#weaningbaby#mukbang#cookingvideo#babyrecipes#toddlerfood#healthysnacksforkids #healthybreakfast#healthyrecipes#babyfood#babymeals#blw#blwideas #blwrecipes #blwtips#momtips#nycmom#momvlog
